author: 4 Ever Green
description:
In this video we’re showing the most beautiful eyes in the animal kingdom from crystal clear blues to glowing gold rainbow shades and patterns that look unreal. You’ll see close up wildlife shots of animals whose eyes are not only beautiful but also built for hunting night vision deep water and survival in the wild.
Some eyes reflect light like mirrors some change color and some have shapes you rarely notice in real life.
Watch till the end because the last few animals have eyes that look straight out of a fantasy movie.
title: Most Beautiful Eyes in The Animal Kingdom
